name: Vega de Santa María (Spain)
description: Four horizontal stripes of green, white, blue and white in the proportions 3:1:1:1, the green stripe charged with a yellow star.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 12 February 2002 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 46 of 6 March 2002); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of four horizontal stripes in the proportions 1/2, 1/6, 1/6 and 1/6, green with a twelve-pointed star above and white, blue and white below.
